bluf: Socially Powerful is a London based influencer agency, founder led (James Hacking) and founded 2016, with offices listed in New York, Dubai and Beijing, selling creators, paid social and social commerce to enterprise beauty, gaming, tech and FMCG brands on a proprietary AI platform, ARIA. The headline is attention at scale: work for Amazon, TikTok, L'Oréal, Primark and Red Bull and a ULTA x L'Oréal TikTok campaign at 137M views. Horus reads it Favored at 18.9. The one thing a rival should know: it sells paid social with no pixel on its own site, no measurement depth and no pricing model on record.
doing:
The positioning line reads: award winning global social and influencer agency connecting brands with high impact creators, using its own AI backed platform and real time analytics for measurable ROI. In plain words, a creator agency selling reach by the million that wants to be bought on data. The headline claim is the ULTA x L'Oréal TikTok campaign at 137M views; the seeding page claims 2M+ vetted creators and 200M+ influencer profiles for gifting.

The sold mix is narrow, breadth 4. Creator & Influencer leads at score 3: the title and H1 call it a global influencer marketing agency, with seeding, gifting, KOL and creator pages and 17 case studies. Paid Social scores 2 at core on a dedicated page about its in house team, TikTok native creative and influencer amplification, with a US paid role open. Data & Measurement and Retail Media score 1; everything else scores 0. The one proprietary item is ARIA, an AI powered influencer platform and creator database; no partner is listed.

AI posture: it pitches campaigns powered by AI technology and real time analytics, with ARIA as an AI powered creator discovery tool. Nothing in the record audits ARIA; AI Search and AI Automation score 0.

Dated moves: none, and no news items. Dated activity is case studies: Simba Sleep MENA, Uber Eats UAE and PUBG Mobile MENA all dated 2026-09-28, Biolage 2026-09-14, the rest 2023. The jobs list holds 10 US and UK roles in account management, project management, talent acquisition and community management (the deepening pass counted 13); it promotes its own events, The Shelf Life of Influence 2026 and Systems of Influence in New York, in LinkedIn ads.

Pricing signals: the main navigation includes a Procurement page, but no prices were captured. Absent for an agency of this claimed scale: an employee count, any measurement or attribution case, any owned audience line and any Google ad of its own.
clients:
The client type on record is enterprise across beauty, fashion, FMCG, gaming, technology and luxury; the home market is the UK, with the newest cases run from Dubai.

The record names 27 clients: 22 observed and 5 names only, though five rows duplicate a client (Uber Eats, Lenovo Legion, Medik8, IT Cosmetics, PUBG). The 2026-09-28 cases: Simba Sleep MENA (a Middle East launch, share of voice up 4%), Uber Eats UAE (400K+ Instagram impressions, read as social and AI) and PUBG Mobile MENA (8M+ views). Biolage (2026-09-14) came for social: 30 creators, 21M views. The 2023 cases: The Body Shop (Middle East), 30M impressions, 15% sales uplift; ULTA Beauty and L'Oréal, the 137M view TikTok campaign; The Gym Group (500 nano creators, 15M views), TikTok itself (a Western market launch at 500M+ views) and Medik8 (followers up 486%) are read as social and brand; Lenovo Legion, Xiaomi, Tefal, IT Cosmetics x L'Oréal and Azzaro each carry a 2023 influencer case with views, impressions or reach in the tens of millions. Leffe is read from a campaign slug, Wella as paid and social from the paid social page.

DAZN and ESL Gaming are case slugs with no captured work and Amazon, Primark and Red Bull are homepage logos, their needs inferred from the creator and paid social mix it leads with. Shared clients: L'Oréal also sits with publicis-sapient and artefact, Amazon with media-monks and precis-digital, ULTA Beauty with power-digital and PUBG Mobile MENA with media-monks.

The observed mix is social and creators (share 0.878), then brand (0.074) and AI (0.048). These brands buy reach, and KJ8 (Human provenance becomes a distribution signal) prices that reach on provenance, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that they ask next for labelled human creator work and the measurement depth the record lacks.
house: Say and do: 2 of 3 tested lines are practised on its own house. Creator & Influencer is corroborated: its own Instagram, TikTok and YouTube channels are linked from the site. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: the Ad Library shows 7 company page ads, a floor, one reading '86% of FMCG marketers say loyalty is weakening', others announcing panellists for The Shelf Life of Influence 2026. Paid Social is contradicted: no social ad pixel runs on its own site. The Transparency Center shows 0 Google ads. The tag stack is GTM, GA4 and HubSpot on WordPress, with no pixel, test tool or ABM stack. Cadence is split: the compile's sitemap read lists 768 URLs with 0 updated in 90 days and 1 in 365, while the own site read found case pages with lastmod 2026-09-28 and 2026-09-14. It publishes no llms.txt, blocks no AI crawlers and has 0 AI topic URLs. No Meta or TikTok ad library reading is on record.

It is best placed for KJ8, human provenance becoming a distribution signal, driven by Creator & Influencer at +2, and for KJ4, the platforms absorbing the execution layer, on Data & Measurement at +2. openings:
The strongest opening is measurement. Socially Powerful sells measurable ROI and real time analytics in its positioning line, yet the record shows Data & Measurement at score 1, P4 partial with no first party data or measurement depth, and case excerpts that report views, reach and engagements. A rival that prices creator work on outcomes and shows attribution is likely, with moderate confidence, to win an enterprise beauty or FMCG review, since the record lists no pricing model behind its Procurement page (P5 unknown). The falsifier: a published measurement product or a case on record tying creator spend to sales.

The contradiction to lead with is paid social sold with no social ad pixel on its own site. The second gap is provenance: best placed for KJ8, yet nothing in the record shows AI labelling or human provenance proof, so the first agency to sell labelled creator work as a product takes that tailwind.

Contestable clients are the shoppers: L'Oréal (publicis-sapient, artefact), Amazon (media-monks, precis-digital), ULTA Beauty (power-digital) and PUBG Mobile MENA (media-monks), plus the names only rows: 5 of its 27 clients are names only. An offshore rate undercut is very unlikely to matter at a displacement of 26.0.
